description: This file defines the IoTEventsDataClient class which extends AwsClient to interact with AWS IoT Events Data service. It includes method annotations for synchronous and asynchronous operations related to alarm and detector management.

classes.name: IoTEventsDataClient
classes.description: A client class for AWS IoT Events Data service, extending AwsClient to provide specific methods for interacting with the service.

methods.name: batchAcknowledgeAlarmAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously acknowledges a batch of alarms.

methods.name: batchDeleteDetectorAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a batch of detectors.

methods.name: batchDisableAlarmAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disables a batch of alarms.

methods.name: batchEnableAlarmAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously enables a batch of alarms.

methods.name: batchPutMessageAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously puts a batch of messages.

methods.name: batchResetAlarmAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously resets a batch of alarms.

methods.name: batchSnoozeAlarmAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously snoozes a batch of alarms.

methods.name: batchUpdateDetectorAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates a batch of detectors.
